head: 695b8ba13a14fffa4dfb2fc964b3501672f831e3
claim: a bot's turn now stops at maxToolCalls (default 30) with a limit event and one plain failed end, so a model repeating a tool call cannot spend without bound

runs.command: npx tsc -b packages/pi > "$DONE_DONE_EVIDENCE_ROOT/build.log" 2>&1 && sh scripts/test.sh 'packages/pi/test/*.test.ts' > "$DONE_DONE_EVIDENCE_ROOT/pi-tests.log" 2>&1 && node .agents/skills/done-done-verify-byokit/capture/pi-tool-cap.mjs

steps.start: A built checkout, a bot with a tool, a kit with maxToolCalls 4, and a loopback stand-in model that calls the tool every time it is asked
steps: Refuse a tool call cap of zero, a negative and a fraction at construction
Send a prompt to a model repeating one tool call until the cap
Send a normal prompt that uses three tool calls under the cap
steps.result: A bot turn stops at maxToolCalls with a limit event and one plain failed end naming the limit while the process stays up, a repeated tool call cannot spend without bound, and a turn under the cap is untouched

verdicts.seen: Read 3 log lines. Line 1: maxToolCalls 0, -3, 1.5 refused at construction with bad-limit x3. Line 2: repeated tool call ran 5 tool calls, limit event {"type":"limit","toolCalls":4,"limit":4}, end {"ok":false,"message":"Stopped: this turn reached its limit of 4 tool calls (maxToolCalls)..."}, process still up true. Line 3: next turn counts from zero: 3 tool calls, ok true, no limit event. This matches the outcome: a limit event plus one plain failed end. The default of 30 is not shown, but the cap behavior is. The 5 tool calls against a limit of 4 is slightly odd, but the stop is still bounded.

Read 13 test lines, all with a check mark. Summary: tests 13, pass 13, fail 0, cancelled 0, skipped 0. The relevant test, 'a model that repeats one tool call is stopped at the cap with a plain result, and a normal turn is untouched', passed. The ~/.pi folder is unchanged. No failure is shown.
